Assumptions.description: Every setting that shaped the result, echoed so a run can be reproduced.
Assumptions.title: Assumptions

BestIs.description: The config index with the best IS value per ranked metric. OOS is never ranked (X-3).
BestIs.title: BestIs

CloseBelowMa.description: Exit at the next open after a close below the moving average.
CloseBelowMa.title: CloseBelowMa

DataMeta.description: `meta.json`: describes one dataset. `benchmark` is excluded from every universe.
DataMeta.title: DataMeta

EdgeMetrics.description: Strategy minus random, per metric. Null when either side is null.
EdgeMetrics.title: EdgeMetrics

ExitConfig.description: A named set of 1 to 6 exits, each of a distinct type.
ExitConfig.title: ExitConfig

Guides.description: Stop and target guides from the baseline config's IS trades only (X-5).
Guides.title: Guides

IndOperand.description: An indicator value, optionally shifted back `offset` bars and scaled by `mult`.
IndOperand.title: IndOperand

IndicatorSpec.description: One registry row. Non windowed indicators (price fields) take no `n`.
IndicatorSpec.title: IndicatorSpec

NotImplementedBody.description: The 501 body while a use case's scope feature has not landed.
NotImplementedBody.title: NotImplementedBody

Rule.description: An entry rule: 1 to 8 conditions joined by AND. No hidden price filter (ADR-013).
Rule.title: Rule

StopAtr.description: Stop loss `k` ATRs (of length `n`) below the entry fill.
StopAtr.title: StopAtr

StopPct.description: Stop loss a fixed percent below the entry fill.
StopPct.title: StopPct

Target.description: Profit target a fixed percent above the entry fill.
Target.title: Target

TimeExit.description: Exit after a fixed number of bars held.
TimeExit.title: TimeExit

TradeMetrics.description: Per trade metrics. No CAGR, max DD or Sharpe in trade mode (X-8).
TradeMetrics.title: TradeMetrics

TrailPct.description: Trailing stop a fixed percent below the highest high since entry.
TrailPct.title: TrailPct

ValueOperand.description: A fixed number, such as the 5 in `close > 5`.
ValueOperand.title: ValueOperand
